rules.description: All exported config keys must be declared in the validation schema
Unknown environment key policy must be explicitly declared as 'reject' or 'ignore'
At least one environment key must be required (otherwise config module provides no startup guarantee)
Keys whose names suggest secrets (password, token, secret, key) must be marked with secret:true
The config module must be the only place in the codebase that reads from process.env
Invalid or missing required config must cause startup failure (non-zero exit or thrown error)
